title: AlertCapabilities
description: What a selection of sources supports and what it cannot reach. The form, the save and the matching plan all derive from the same place, so the form cannot offer something the save would reject.

sources.description: Every source of the alert type.

triggers.description: Triggers at least one selected source supports.

containerEntities.description: Entity types a name filter can be scoped to: the union over the selected sources.

eventTypes.description: Event types at least one selected source emits. Values to match, never enforced at save.

recipientCategories.description: Who inside the platform alerts on the selected sources can be sent to: a category any of them offers. Offered in the form, never enforced on save.
